curation_note_chirho: H1990 is the place name Ham in Genesis 14:5, confirmed by OSHB b/1990 + HR/Np and the pinned HebrewStrong proper-location entry. An existing cluster-of-houses illustration is reused as a general named-place mnemonic. It does not claim to reconstruct Ham or settle its geographical extent. The original sixteen-cell batch remains held over its separate H2082 source disagreement; no request or retry history is changed.

source_art_chirho.visual_review_chirho: Owner inspected the actual 128px WebP on 2026-11-01: a compact group of small tan dwellings and green vegetation, isolated on a transparent background. Suitable as an explicitly generic place mnemonic; no named-site reconstruction or new art approval is claimed.
